description: Compass plugin hooks. Every entry runs a command, never an agent, so no hook costs a turn of the agent's token budget. PreToolUse runs `compass guard` on Bash, Write, and Edit: it denies a call that would destroy information (a delete or git discard, a Write that empties a file or guts a vault document, an Edit that blanks a long vault passage) through the JSON permission decision, scratch areas exempt; the entry sets `onFailure: "block"` (Claude Code 2.1.295 or later) so a guard that crashes, cannot start, or times out blocks the subagent call instead of letting it through. PostToolUse runs `compass context-check` after every main-agent tool call: it measures the session's context from its transcript and, the first time usage reaches 80% of the window and once more at 95%, returns `continue: false` with a stopReason suggesting /compass:handoff, so the tool that ran finishes and no next step starts; its shell skips subagent events before Python, the same prefilter the guard inverts. PostToolUse also runs `compass sync` on any vault write to regenerate index.md and the tag index, then records a capture signal for the artifact written (`handoff-written` under handoffs/, `vault-write` otherwise). Stop runs `compass capture-check`, which bumps the main-agent turn counter, evaluates whether a capture opportunity is due, and on due emits the stop-hook block contract naming the opportunity directory so the capture pass runs as a real turn rather than as prose the model can skip. SubagentStop runs `compass capture-signal` for each Compass agent under both its bare name (agents installed into a project's .claude/agents) and its plugin-scoped name (`compass:builder` and so on, as agents loaded from a plugin carry), listed side by side in the matcher because a matcher of plain names and pipes is matched exactly; it writes the finishing subagent's final report to a capture file under .compass/tmp/subagent-captures/ and records a typed signal keyed on agent_type with any leading `<plugin>:` prefix stripped (validator-finished, debug-finished, builder-finished, or subagent-finished). TeammateIdle runs the same capture-signal command; that event's payload carries only a teammate name (no agent type, no message), so it records a weak activity signal and writes no capture file. Every command first checks that the project's CLI is installed and exits 0 when it is not, so a project the plugin is loaded for but not set up in (or mid-setup) is never blocked. The guard judges subagent calls only, identified by the agent id in the event; the main agent, working with the human, is never denied, and its calls never start Python: the guard's shell reads the event and exits before the interpreter unless an agent id is present. The CLI parses each hook's stdin JSON, self-filters where relevant to avoid a write loop, and never exits 2 (which would block the user's turn). The PostToolUse entry is split three ways (Write, Edit, MultiEdit) because the `if` clause does not support `||` boolean OR; each entry has its own permission-rule pattern. SessionStart additionally runs `compass self-update` (matcher startup only): refreshes the install from its recorded source - sha-gated, throttled, silent unless it updated, never blocking. The same matcher runs `compass drift --hook`: when HEAD differs from the newest row of the drift log it starts a detached scan of the vault's code references, index lines and catalog rows against git, under a lock file, and returns at once without output. SessionStart also runs `compass session-state` (matcher compact only): after a compaction it injects the session's state block (open tasks, decisions, files touched, uncommitted changes, last test run) as additional context; its shell skips subagent events before Python, matching the quoted `"agent_id"` or `"agent_type"` key so text the human typed after /compact that mentions those words still reaches the CLI. PreCompact runs the same command on every compaction, manual or auto, and prints the summary instructions that name what the summary must keep.

hooks.command: [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" ] || exit 0; input=$(cat); case "$input" in *agent_id*|*agent_type*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" guard --hook; else printf '%s' "$input" | python "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.claude/cli/compass" guard --hook; fi
